requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation is incomplete and does not properly integrate with Flask's routing system to extract route decorators and parameters for accurate group labeling.
requirement.contract: The Flask hook must intercept Flask application execution to: 1. Detect Flask route decorators (@app.route) and error handlers (@app.errorhandler) 2. Extract route patterns and parameters for proper labeling 3. Set appropriate group labels like '@app.route("/")' and '@app.errorhandler(404)' 4. Handle parameterized routes like '/hello/<xxxx>/<yyyy>' with extracted parameter values 5. Integrate with the existing hook system to ensure proper grouping of server-side requests
requirement.acceptance: - test_flask_endpoint passes with group.label == '@app.route("/")' - test_flask_endpoint_with_parameters passes with group.label == '@app.route("/hello/<xxxx>/<yyyy>")' and proper parameter extraction - test_flask_not_found passes with group.label == '@app.errorhandler(404)'

requirement.description: The Flask hook lacks proper integration with Flask's application lifecycle to capture server-side requests effectively.
requirement.contract: The Flask hook must: 1. Properly instrument Flask's request handling to capture server-side HTTP requests 2. Ensure that requests initiated by Flask applications are correctly labeled with their route information 3. Support the server=True flag in httprecord context manager for capturing server-side traffic
requirement.acceptance: All Flask server hook tests pass with client=False, server=True context

requirement.description: The current Flask hook implementation doesn't support extracting and applying Flask-specific labels for route matching and parameter handling.
requirement.contract: The Flask hook implementation must: 1. Parse Flask route decorators to extract route patterns and method names 2. Handle URL parameter extraction from route patterns like '/hello/<param>' 3. Create appropriate group labels that match the expected test assertions 4. Support error handlers with proper labeling like '@app.errorhandler(404)'
requirement.acceptance: - test_flask_endpoint_with_parameters correctly extracts parameters and creates full_label with parameter values - test_flask_not_found correctly identifies and labels error handlers
